payload.rationale_summary: The rating reflects Omega Logistics' growing market share in 3PL logistics, improving revenue trajectory (+12% CAGR), and strategic warehouse investments. Rating constrained by rising cheque returns (15/quarter), elevated utilization (96%+), covenant breaches on DSCR and cheque returns, and thin profit margins.
key_rating_drivers: Growing 3PL logistics player with expanding warehouse network
Conduct concerns: Rising cheque returns, DPD up to 32 days

rating_sensitivity.upgrade: Sustained margin improvement >15% EBITDA, clean conduct 4 quarters
rating_sensitivity.downgrade: DPD >60 days, DSCR <1.0x, or further covenant breaches
